title: Jets blow late double-digit lead, lose to Packers in overtime, 20-17

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets blow late double-digit lead, lose to Packers in overtime, 20-17
sources.description: The Jets blew a 10-point fourth quarter lead and then hurt themselves with offensive line breakdowns and penalties in overtime, setting up rookie Trey Smack’s game-winning kick.
